title: AttachDetachDataDisksRequest
description: Specifies the input for attaching and detaching data disks.

dataDisksToAttach.description: The list of managed data disks to be attached.

diskId.description: ID of the managed data disk.

detachOption.description: Specifies the detach behavior to be used while detaching a disk or which is already in the process of detachment.

dataDisksToDetach.description: The list of managed data disks to be detached.
